analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 22 Oct 2026
key_insights: Risk-off tape driven by an AI unwind at 12:33pm ET on 22 Oct 2026: RTY -16bps, SPX -103bps, NDX -220bps. NVDA, AMD, MU, META, SPCX and AMZN account for about 60% of the NDX weakness.
S&P ex AI (SPXXAI) is +110bps, outperforming SPX -103bps. SPXXAI has outperformed SPX by 6pp so far in October as the market broadens out.

Yields are lower, with the 10-year through 5% despite higher WTI. CTAs are very short global government bonds and are approaching their short-term threshold level, so lower yields could unlock more CTA demand.
Unwind across factor baskets: Software vs Semis (GSPUSOSE) +750bps, its biggest move in over a month. AI Winners vs AI at Risk (GSPUARTI) -900bps, the 5th worst session of the year.
High Beta Momentum (GSPRHIMO) is -710bps and has erased all YTD gains. It was up 70% at the June highs.
HF VIP Long vs Shorts (GSTHVIPP) is -330bps, flagged as a pain barometer for hedge funds. Neoclouds (GSXUNEOC) are -600bps and remain under pressure.

META is -550bps as investors focus on future capital needs. GS says it is now viewed as a levered bet on Muse. META is dragging MegaCap Tech (GSX1MEGA) -240bps, while AAPL is +45bps and is the defensive name investors are rotating into.
Liquidity: exchange volumes are tracking +10% vs the 20-day moving average. Top-of-book liquidity is healthy at $9.5mm on the touch (+1% vs 20dma).

GS desk flow: activity is 4 out of 10 and flow is 11% better for sale. Long-only clients are skewed 22% to sell, with supply in tech, staples and industrials and modest demand in financials and industrials. Hedge funds are 9% better for sale, with supply in tech and industrials and demand in staples and real estate.

Chart of the Day: the AI Winners basket is approaching July levels but is now through the 200-day moving average. RSI is 30, the same as in July before a bounce. Max drawdown was -24% in July and is currently -23%.
